test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II (Statistics) Official Paper-II (Held On: 19 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT true?

options.text: Frequency polygon facilitates the comparison of more than one series of data
Histograms are constructed using cumulative frequencies
Histogram consists of a set of rectangles with bases on horizontal axes
Histogram consists of a set of rectangles with not centres at class marks

solution:
**The Correct Option is: Histograms are constructed using cumulative frequencies**

**Explanation:**

1) Frequency polygon facilitates the comparison of more than one series of data

 Frequency polygons are drawn using points at class marks and connected by lines, making it easy to compare multiple data sets on the same graph.

∴ It is True

2) Histograms are constructed using cumulative frequencies

Histograms use class frequencies, not cumulative frequencies. Cumulative frequency graphs are called ogives, not histograms.

∴ It is Not true

3) Histogram consists of a set of rectangles with bases on horizontal axes

The width of each rectangle corresponds to the class interval, and the height corresponds to frequency.

∴ It is True

4) Histogram not consists of a set of rectangles with not centres at class marks

It Is also true.
